text: …せや　ここで　あったのも　なんかの　ごえんや！

structure.jp: ここで　あったのも
なんかの　ごえんや！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. ここで あったの = 'the fact that we met here'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: や is the Kansai dialect form of だ, 'is'. なんかの ごえんや = 'it's some kind of fate'.
